checkpoint: Calc preserves worksheet tab colors through XLSX and ODS and paints them in the existing tab strip

fixtures.evidence: Unmodified start package. Exact four sheet names and native RGB values after import, Worker serialization, ODS and XLSX reopen. XLSX uses ARGB and writes sheetPr before sheetViews. ODS preserves visible and hidden sheet colors.

The ordinary worksheet test uses the unchanged theme part and original sheetPr content from the chart sheet and asserts FF9BBB59. Complete chart-sheet and chart drawing import are outside this checkpoint.
